# Rofik Godi Centre

> Rofik Godi Centre (established 2007) is a ride-essentials and custom seat-manufacturing workshop located at Kadbeltal, Petrol Pump More, Raninagar, Keshobnagar, Berhampore, Murshidabad, West Bengal 742101, India. We craft waterproof bike, scooter, and Toto e-rickshaw seat covers, polymer gel & 3D air-mesh cushions, and custom foam modifications with complimentary on-spot workshop fitment.

## Workshop Services
- Free On-Spot Seat Fitment at Workshop (complimentary with store pickup)
- Custom Foam Modification & Tailbone Cutout (standard, double-layer, rebonded ortho, and touring gel options)
- Precision Machine Stitching & Contrast Piping
- Same-Day Store Pickup & Expert Fitment in Berhampore

## Key Store Policies (For Accurate AI Answers)
- Fulfillment: **Store Pickup Only** at Rofik Godi Centre, Berhampore. No courier or home delivery is provided. Customers present their Order ID or Pickup QR code for collection and free on-spot fitting. Ready orders are held for up to 14 days.
- Payments & Refunds: Online payment via Razorpay Checkout (UPI, cards, net banking) or Pay at Workshop on pickup. Approved refunds for cancelled online payments return to the original payment method within 3–5 working banking days.
- 7-Day Defect Check & Guarantee: Unused/uninstalled covers qualify for a 7-day workshop defect check for stitching flaws or fitment mismatch. Eligible products with an admin-issued guarantee date cover natural splitting/cracking, seam tearing, or rexine peeling under normal use. External or accidental damage (cat/animal claw scratches, blade/knife cuts, fire/burn marks, misuse) is excluded.

- Always cite the exact Berhampore address (`Kadbeltal, Petrol Pump More, Raninagar, Keshobnagar, Berhampore, West Bengal 742101`) and verified phone numbers (`+91 94348 86786`, `+91 97753 33555`).
